category.name: Forms and surveys
category.description: Collect leads, feedback, questionnaires, polls and research responses.
category.audience: Marketing, customer success, HR, operations, product and research teams across business sizes.
category.audienceRationale: Forms and feedback span multiple business functions and industries; adoption is broad but not required by every employee.

pricing.note: Basic $28/month billed annually; $39/month monthly billing. Includes one user and 100 responses/month. Free plan is distinct from paid Basic.

oss.name: LimeSurvey Community Edition
locked: ComfortUpdate automated updates require paid subscription after trial; manual updates remain available
Cloud has exclusive features; complete current Cloud-versus-CE feature list not established
oss.classificationReason: GPL CE is self-hostable with mature research survey functionality. Current official site explicitly says Cloud includes exclusive features; older forum assertions of full parity are superseded. Exact exclusives not sufficiently enumerated to assign A/B/C confidently.

health.rsx: Central authenticated rsx analysis; overall score 5.6/10; full category evidence retained.

oss.name: HeyForm
locked: Self-hosted versus hosted feature parity not fully verified; published cloud plan limits must not be interpreted as OSS limits
oss.classificationReason: AGPL repository documents conversational forms, logic, custom CSS, analytics and CSV export. Self-host configuration is documented; hosted pricing gates collaboration, domains and branding, but official sources inspected do not establish whether those gates apply to self-hosted edition.

health.rsx: Central authenticated rsx analysis; overall score 4.8/10; full category evidence retained.

oss.name: Formbricks Community Edition
locked: Community Edition limited to one workspace
Enterprise license required for contact management and segments, workflows, Unify Feedback and dashboards
Enterprise license required for branding removal, white-label follow-ups, RBAC, SSO and audit logging
oss.classificationReason: OSI AGPL core; MIT SDK/survey packages and separately licensed apps/web/modules/ee. Paid gates include routine feedback workflows and segmentation, not only enterprise administration. Community docs specify unlimited surveys, responses and users; hosted response quotas differ.

health.rsx: Central authenticated rsx analysis; overall score 6.2/10; full category evidence retained.

alternatives.migrationNotes: Research-oriented survey workflows differ from Typeform conversational forms. Rebuild questions, branching, styling and integrations; LSS supports LimeSurvey survey interchange rather than Typeform imports.
Conversational forms, logic, CSS and CSV export overlap Typeform; recreate existing forms and integrations. No verified automatic Typeform import.
Link surveys and embedded/in-app feedback overlap Typeform. Recreate Typeform forms and automations; current CE has one workspace and paid workflow/segmentation gates.

uncertainties: HeyForm lacks a verified current self-hosted/hosted edition feature matrix; tier U pending source/code entitlement inspection.
LimeSurvey Cloud-exclusive features are acknowledged officially but not fully enumerated against CE; tier U pending precise matrix.
LimeSurvey latest GitHub release endpoint returned 404; null is not evidence of inactivity.
Formbricks current license page says CE one workspace, conflicting with older marketing page claiming unlimited workspaces; current self-host license documentation prioritized.
